failure.exception: ValueError: CV request coverage differs across layers
failure.cause: The CV-only aggregator requires every layer to contain the same request set. The preregistered 203-row FP16 diagnostic holdout is sparse across layers, although all five diagnostic requests have aggregate coverage for every K.
failure.stage: first persisted-event metric replay, before independent model retraining and before runtime-final/summary publication

open_finding.proposed_bounded_fix: Add a precision-specific request-macro aggregator that permits sparse per-layer request coverage, requires the exact five-request union for every K, sums event numerators and denominators within request across all available layers, then macro-averages the five request means. Do not weaken the frozen CV aggregator.
open_finding.proposed_acceptance_test: A production-path test with uneven and zero per-layer cells must reproduce the failure on candidate d4a1264, then require exact five-request aggregate coverage, exact event counts 190/177/152, correct request-macro and event-weighted formulas, rejection of missing/extra requests, and unchanged behavior of the frozen CV aggregator.

claim_limit: No precision metric was produced. This attempt proves model fitting and semantic event generation reached all 75 routed layers, but it does not prove deterministic retraining or feature-precision acceptance.
